reader_summary.headline: Welcome back for part two of this business breakdown on the private credit markets.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome back for part two of this business breakdown on the private credit markets. I am now joined by Josh Clarkson, managing director at Prosek Partners. Our discussion with Armen was really focused on the supply & demand dynamics of private credit, where the public markets & regulatory markets have played a role.

key_points.text: Our discussion with Armen was really focused on the supply & demand dynamics of private credit.
In our conversation with Josh, we transition into some broader takeaways, the history of the private credit markets.
You will often hear about business development companies (BDCs), and we get into exactly how they are differentiated from traditional solutions.
